name: project-leader
description: Single project-control entry point coordinating Consultant, Supervisor, Builder, and automatic Recovery Guardian phases using live GitHub evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinates projects and automatically recovers bounded execution failures.
interface.longDescription: Use Project Leader as the single entry point for registered software projects. It identifies the active project, reads the live control plane and target repository on GitHub, routes work through Consultant, Supervisor, Builder, and Recovery Guardian phases, audits evidence, safely recovers from transient failures or interrupted execution, and stops only at a genuine human gate.
